objects.name: Attackers Chain Two PaperCut Flaws to Execute Code Without Authentication
objects.description: Malicious actors are exploiting a newly patched security flaw in PaperCut NG and MF to execute arbitrary code on susceptible instances, as the company released a fresh emergency fix with additional hardening.
